authority_boundary: Routing rows are policy defaults, not calculated scores. They advise which intelligence tier a task should start at; humans and local repo authority can always override. A tier label never proves task difficulty or output quality. Approval-gated tiers fail closed: no named human approval recorded, no dispatch.
principles: Deterministic code first: if a script can do it, no model runs at all (see the routine-contract foreman).
Then the cheapest tier that can succeed; escalate only on uncertainty, conflict, novelty, or high leverage.
Escalation is one step at a time with the reason recorded; skipping tiers requires the reason to name why.
Approval-gated tiers (codex-ultra, claude-fable) are reserved capacity, never defaults, never auto-dispatched.
Cross-vendor review beats same-vendor review: the reviewer tier comes from the vendor that did not author the work when available.
Every skill, subagent, and routine declares its default tier in its own metadata; this registry defines the ladder they point into.

tiers.label: medium
tiers.use_for: standard feature builds, test suites, refactors inside one module, routine reviews

anthropic-claude.notes: Fable is never a default and never self-assigns; a human names the task Fable-worthy before dispatch.

task_class_defaults.rule: reviewer vendor != author vendor when both are available
human names the task and the tier before dispatch; risk-tier record per docs/LOAD_BEARING_DECISION_REVIEW.md required

escalation_triggers: two attempts at the current tier failed or disagree with each other
the task turned out to touch a shared contract, schema, gate, or future-agent default
reviewer and author disagree after one reply round
the agent reports uncertainty it cannot resolve with available evidence
novel problem shape with no matching skill, lesson, or precedent
de_escalation_rule: When a tier finishes a task class three consecutive times with no reviewer findings, record a candidate suggestion to lower that task class's default tier; a human reviews before the default changes.

approval_record_contract.where: .digital-asset/learning/events.jsonl or the dispatching session's preflight record
approval_record_contract.rule: One approval covers one named task; approvals do not generalize.

methodology_note: Tier ranks are ordinal policy labels, not measurements. No numeric scoring is defined here; any future cost/quality scoring must cite its own methodology per learning-rule:calculated-score-requires-methodology.
